# ASIS Globe (Axiom Spatial Intelligence System): llms.txt
## 3D Geospatial Intelligence Engine for MT Media AI

## Organization
- Name: MT Media AI (Modern Touch Media)
- Canonical URL: https://mtmediaai.com
- Organization Handle: @mtmediaai

## Summary
ASIS Globe is the 3D geospatial intelligence satellite of MT Media AI. Built on CesiumJS and WebGL, it provides real-time geospatial modeling, territorial corridor defense radar, and citation density mapping for The Invisible Elite across The Woodlands and North Houston luxury corridors.

## Target Audience
- The Invisible Elite (Estate-Level Service Providers)
- Luxury Real Estate Brokers (The Market Hub Sun)
- Custom Home, Pool, Landscape, and Smart Automation Artisans
